name: Source-bound affine microscopy moments
status: Reusable research executable; not admitted commercial Alpha or a production protected capsule.

prerequisites.core_runtime: Python 3.11-3.13 per repository; observed Python 3.12.14 and NumPy 2.3.2.
prerequisites.evaluation_dependencies: Observed SciPy 1.17.0; Numcodecs 0.16.3 for offline source-chunk decoding.
prerequisites.integration_dependencies: Pinned existing Python/JavaScript source closure, Pydantic 2.11.7, cryptography 50.0.2; observed Node 24.22.1 differs from repository-requested 22.17.1.
inputs: A permitted NPY 1.0/2.0 integer label array with nonempty spatial dimensions
Source rights, trustworthy calibration and an explicitly authorized useful mission supplied by the caller

scope.labels: Zero is background; each nonzero signed or unsigned integer identity denotes its supplied support, including disconnected support.
scope.memory_caveat: These bound source-file/payload size, not total peak process memory or runtime.
scope.accepted_axes: Distinct x/y/z names matching dimensionality; source and target axis sets equal.
scope.source_metric: Axis-aligned positive finite spacing and finite origin; units converted to micrometers.
scope.map: Explicit finite homogeneous affine geometric pushforward; rows follow target_axes, columns follow source_axes; physical micrometers.
scope.measure_semantics: Native source physical support and mapped geometric support are returned separately. A pure coordinate re-expression does not alter physical specimen volume.

provenance.construction: AI-assisted engineering under the user-directed study; implements established geometric formulas.

rights.new_code: Apache-2.0; retain study LICENSE and applicable notices.
rights.upstream_code: Retain the licenses/notices supplied in integration/vendor/.
rights.public_data: Blin et al. IDR0062 and Walther et al. IDR0052: CC BY 4.0 with creator credit, DOI/source URLs and extraction changes; see evidence/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.
capability_payload_excludes: Protected evaluation answers or training material
rights.distribution_note: Research evidence is distributed for inspection; it is not part of the retained executable payload or proof of permission for a new mission.

evidence.held_data_scope: Two partitions in one public image/timepoint; 48 authored maps.
evidence.independence: Separately executed workers and recipient processes within the same AI-assisted team; no external independent validation.

costs.cost_boundary: A covers complete paid outcome and required learning; B only additional screening/retention/sharing/upkeep; C optional extra R&D. Scenario costs do not price actual research.

admission_and_authority.technical_research_use: Finite scoped validation supports research reuse with fresh mission checks.
admission_and_authority.primary_simulated_admission: Reject after CAD5 screening under zero retained benefit.
admission_and_authority.scope_of_fixture_access: Existing research lifecycle conformance only; artificial positive admission records are separate from actual commercial evidence.
admission_and_authority.new_mission_authority: Must be granted separately; reusable bytes do not grant execution or settlement authority.
admission_and_authority.revocation_limit: Blocks new mediated access; cannot erase bytes already retrieved.
admission_and_authority.network_sharing: No live network grant was made. Future rights-cleared admitted sharing must use existing protected-network identity, revocation and Jobs-validator/settlement boundaries.

limitations: No segmentation biology, complete-cell coverage or registration validity
No nonlinear, topology, intensity or clinical mission
Cannot infer unstated intent or verify hidden physical calibration
No persistent moment cache in this frozen CLI
No sustained specialist superiority, model-weight training or compounding claim
No live customer acceptance, revenue or production-scope qualification

maintenance.admission_rule: Retain only when credible realized eligible reuse has expected benefits above additional cost/risk relative to the competent recipient.
revalidation_triggers: Changed mission meaning, axes, calibration or map semantics
Higher failures, support burden or maintenance cost
maintenance.version_rule: Preserve this source and all old outcomes; freeze a new version before prospective fresh confirmation.
maintenance.gym: No model-weight training or optional Gym refinement was executed; such development would need a distinct artifact, feedback record, budget and fresh evaluation.
